evidence_scope: Extended controller comparison: masked_policy filters adjacent walls; observed_map adds symbolic episodic mapping/planning from the same local sensors and known grid size. map_without_policy removes the learned tie-break prior. These are engineered assistance, not raw neural gains. Zero collisions follow legal filtering. No controller receives the full obstacle map or teacher action. Frozen synthetic grid navigation; no teacher assistance or training. No-graft and no-recurrence are inference-time interventions on identical weights, not separately trained baselines. Random is seeded; shortest_path has full-map access. Declared seeds are not proof of unseen training worlds. SPL counts successful cell moves; collisions and attempted steps are separate. Teacher agreement uses one deterministic shortest-path tie-break. No biological advantage or pretrained language capability established. Steering controls add engineered assistance: cx_steer adds a hand-selected goal/heading cosine prior and legal wall mask to learned logits; cx_without_policy uses zero learned logits for action selection. Heading is read directly from observations, not the diagnostic ring attractor. These are inference-time interventions, not a cell-specific PFL circuit reconstruction, learned biological mechanism or separately trained comparison.
